poll.question: The panther at the fern edge watches Mutu sleep. Wesley holds tight. Chills waits unmoved. Does the wild one stay?

options.label: Let it stay
options.desc: Mutu called it here. The wild one's fear is fading. Trust what the cat knows.

options.label: Drive it away
options.desc: Wesley's right. One wrong move ends everything. The boundary holds at dawn.

options.label: Set the boundary
options.desc: Chills and Wesley agree: fern edge, not fire. The circle stays safe. The wild stays close.

in_play.label: Welcome the panther
in_play.desc: Mutu brought it here. Loneliness found them both.
